description_sq:
Apartament 1+1 ne shitje, pjese e nje objekti te ri Elitar pjese e nje super projekti me 30 kate banimi tek Ali Demi
Objekti ndodhet ne nje prej zonave me te mira te kryeqytetit sic eshte Ali Demi, prane te gjitha facilitetetve per nje jetese komode, me nje arkitekture te vecante dhe punime teper cilesore.
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 60m2, planimetri shume te rregullt te organizuar ne sallonin e ndenjes bashke me ambientin e gatimit ,1 dhome gjumi, korridori qe ben shperndarjen e ambienteve, 1 tualete dhe ballkoni me pamje te lire.Objekti njihet per arkitekturen e vecante, hapesirat e perbashketa,.
Projekti eshte nje prej me te mirave ne zone sa i perket cilesise se punimeve edhe fasileteteve qe do ofrojej.
Per me shume informacion kontaktoni!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale, part of a new Elite building, part of a super project with 30 residential floors in Ali Demi. The building is located in one of the best areas of the capital, such as Ali Demi, near all the facilities for a comfortable life, with a special architecture and high-quality works. The apartment has a total area of ​​60m2, a very regular layout organized in the living room together with the kitchen area, 1 bedroom, the corridor that divides the premises, 1 toilet and a balcony with a free view. The building is known for its special architecture, common spaces. The project is one of the best in the area in terms of the quality of the works and the facilities that would be offered.
